name: Pulse & Iron
description: High-energy sketches for training, running and movement: locked-in running cadences (160, 170 and 180 SPM), heavy lifting grooves, a timed Tabata interval bell, cardio house, synthwave and a cool-down stretch.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Warm-Up Stride
sketches.description: Ease into motion at 118 BPM: a crisp four-on-the-floor kick, bright Dorian chord stabs and a rising arpeggio to get the blood moving.
sketches.source:
setcpm(118/4)

// Crisp four-on-the-floor with off-beat open hats
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").shape(.15).gain(.75),
  s("[~ oh]*4").gain(.3),
  s("~ cp ~ cp").room(.25).gain(.45),
  s("hh*16").hpf(7000).gain("[.15 .3]*8")
)

// Bouncy Dorian bassline
bass: note("<[d2 ~ d2 a1 ~ d2 f2 g2] [c2 ~ c2 g1 ~ c2 e2 f2]>")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(800).lpenv(2).lpdecay(.12)
  .decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.08).gain(.5)

// Warm chord stabs opening up over eight bars
chords: note("<[d3,f3,a3,c4] [g3,b3,d4,f4] [e3,g3,b3,d4] [a3,c4,e4,g4]>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .lpf(sine.range(900, 2600).slow(8)).decay(.3).sustain(.2).release(.2)
  .room(.4).gain(.24)

// Bright rising arpeggio
arp: n("0 2 4 6 7 6 4 2").scale("D:dorian").transpose(12)
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.12).sustain(0)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).pan(sine.slow(4)).gain(.22)

sketches.name: Easy Jog (160 SPM)
sketches.description: A steady 160 steps-per-minute cruising cadence: every quarter-note kick and snare matches a footstrike, carried by an upbeat synthwave bass and arpeggio.
sketches.source:
setcpm(160/4)

// Every beat is a footstrike at 160 steps per minute
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").shape(.2).gain(.8),
  s("~ sd ~ sd").room(.3).gain(.55),
  s("[~ hh]*4").hpf(6000).gain(.35)
)

// Driving eighth-note octave bass: Am, F, C, G
bass: note("<[a1 a2]*4 [f1 f2]*4 [c2 c3]*4 [g1 g2]*4>")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(1100).lpq(3)
  .decay(.12).sustain(.3).release(.05).gain(.48)

// Forward-moving arpeggio
arp: n("0 2 4 7 4 2 0 4").add("<0 5 2 6>").scale("A:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("square").pw(.3).lpf(2400).decay(.1).sustain(0)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).gain(.2)

// Wide horizon pad
pad: note("<[a3,c4,e4] [f3,a3,c4] [c4,e4,g4] [g3,b3,d4]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.25)
  .attack(.3).release(1).lpf(1800).room(.6).gain(.18)

sketches.name: Tempo Run (170 SPM)
sketches.description: A 170 SPM tempo-run metronome disguised as melodic drum and bass: a crisp click-kick on every step, rolling breaks, a reese bass and uplifting chords.
sketches.source:
setcpm(170/4)

// A clear pulse on all four beats for 170 SPM, plus a fast break
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").lpf(400).gain(.75),
  s("rim*4").hpf(1800).gain(.28),
  s("~ sd ~ sd").room(.2).gain(.6),
  s("hh*16").hpf(8000).gain("[.35 .15 .25 .15]*4")
)

// Warm reese bass propelling the low end
reese: note("<e1 c1 g1 d1>").s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.35)
  .lpf(sine.range(300, 900).slow(4)).lpq(3)
  .attack(.03).sustain(1).release(.2).gain(.4)

// Uplifting chord progression: Em, C, G, D
pad: note("<[e3,g3,b3,d4] [c3,e3,g3,b3] [g3,b3,d4,f#4] [d3,f#3,a3,c#4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .attack(.2).release(.8).lpf(2000).room(.6).gain(.2)

// Sparkling lead motif
lead: n("<[4 ~ 6 ~ 7 ~ 9 ~] [7 ~ 6 ~ 4 ~ 2 ~]>").scale("E:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.2).sustain(0)
  .delay(.35).delaytime(3/16).room(.5).gain(.28)

sketches.name: Race Pace (180 SPM)
sketches.description: Classic 180 steps-per-minute race cadence: a relentless footstrike pulse with an energetic lead and fast arpeggios to hold turnover on fast kilometres.
sketches.source:
setcpm(180/4)

// 180 SPM: three steps every second, locked to the four-on-the-floor
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").shape(.25).gain(.82),
  s("~ [sd,cp] ~ [sd,cp]").room(.2).gain(.6),
  s("[~ oh]*4").gain(.32),
  s("hh*8").hpf(7500).gain(.25)
)

// Galloping bass on Fm, Db, Ab, Eb
bass: note("<f1 db1 ab1 eb1>").ply(8)
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(1200).lpenv(1.5).lpdecay(.08)
  .decay(.1).sustain(.25).release(.04).gain(.48)

// High-energy arpeggiator
arp: n("[0 2 4 7]*2").add("<0 5 2 6>").scale("F:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("square").pw(.25).decay(.08).sustain(0)
  .delay(.25).delaytime(3/16).gain(.22)

// Anthem lead on every second 4-bar phrase
lead: note("<[f4@3 g4 ab4@2 bb4 c5] [db5@3 c5 bb4@2 ab4 g4] [ab4@3 bb4 c5@2 db5 eb5] [c5@4 bb4@2 g4@2]>")
  .mask("<1 1 1 1 0 0 1 1>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2).lpf(3200)
  .attack(.01).decay(.2).sustain(.6).release(.15)
  .room(.4).gain(.26)

sketches.name: Tabata HIIT (20s On / 10s Off)
sketches.description: A built-in interval timer at 120 BPM: four bars (8s) of high-intensity work with driving synths, followed by two bars (4s) of recovery breathing, marked by a boxing bell.
sketches.source:
setcpm(120/4)

// 6-bar loop: 4 bars WORK (1 1 1 1), 2 bars REST (0 0)
const work = "<1 1 1 1 0 0>"
const rest = "<0 0 0 0 1 1>"

// Boxing bell: triple ring to start work, single low bell to rest
bell: note("<[c5*3 ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~ [c4 ~ ~ ~] ~>")
  .s("sine").fm(3.5).fmh(2.41).decay(.8).sustain(0).release(.8)
  .room(.4).gain(.5)

// WORK: relentless kick, clap and driving acid bass
drums: s("bd*4, ~ cp ~ cp, [~ oh]*4, hh*16").mask(work).shape(.2).gain(.8)
bass: note("c2 c2 eb2 c2 g1 bb1 c2 d2").mask(work)
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(600, 2400).fast(2)).lpq(6).lpenv(2).lpdecay(.1)
  .decay(.12).sustain(.2).release(.05).gain(.5)
stabs: note("[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]").struct("x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x").mask(work)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.25).lpf(2200).decay(.15).sustain(0).gain(.28)

// REST: a calm pad and a steady heartbeat pulse while you catch your breath
recover: note("[c3,g3,eb4]").mask(rest)
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(.5).release(1.5).room(.7).gain(.25)
heart: s("bd ~ ~ ~").mask(rest).lpf(180).gain(.4)

sketches.name: Iron Temple
sketches.description: Heavy half-time lifting music at 140 BPM: aggressive brass stabs, a distorted 808 sub, snapping snares and triplet hat rolls for heavy sets.
sketches.source:
setcpm(140/4)

// Half-time stadium beat: huge snare on beat 3
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").shape(.3).gain(.85),
  s("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [sd,cp] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").room(.35).gain(.75),
  s("hh*8").sometimesBy(.4, x => x.ply("<2 3 4>")).hpf(6500).gain(.35)
)

// Heavy 808 sub with grit and glide
sub: note("<[d1@6 d1 ~ f1@4 a1@4] [bb0@6 bb0 ~ a0@4 c1@4]>")
  .s("sine").mono(1).glide(.06).shape(.35)
  .attack(.005).decay(1.2).sustain(.5).release(.15).gain(.6)

// Menacing low brass hits
brass: note("<[[d2,a2,d3,f3]@3 ~ [d2,a2,d3,f3] ~@3] [[bb1,f2,bb2,d3]@3 ~ [a1,e2,a2,c#3]@4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3)
  .lpf(1100).lpenv(2.5).lpattack(.02).lpdecay(.25)
  .attack(.02).decay(.4).sustain(.3).release(.2).room(.4).gain(.36)

// High tension bell ostinato
bell: note("d4 a4 bb4 a4 f4 a4 d4 e4")
  .s("sine").fm(2.5).fmh(3).decay(.2).sustain(0)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Cardio Engine
sketches.description: Peak-hour tech-house at 128 BPM: a rolling sub-bass groove, filtered synth hooks, crisp claps and a build-and-release filter sweep for bikes, rowers and circuits.
sketches.source:
setcpm(128/4)

// Punchy club kit
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").shape(.2).gain(.82),
  s("[~ oh]*4").gain(.35),
  s("~ cp ~ cp").room(.2).gain(.55),
  s("hh*16").hpf(8000).gain(saw.range(.12, .32).fast(4)),
  s("~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~").pan(.35).gain(.3)
)

// Rolling off-beat tech-house bassline
bass: note("~ g1 g1 ~ g1 ~ bb1 c2 ~ g1 g1 ~ f1 ~ eb1 f1")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(550).lpq(4).lpenv(2).lpdecay(.1)
  .decay(.15).sustain(.2).release(.05).shape(.15).gain(.55)

// Hypnotic synth hook sweeping through the filter
hook: note("[g3 bb3 d4 g3 eb4 d4 bb3 g3]*2")
  .s("square").pw(.2).unison(2).detune(.15)
  .lpf(sine.range(500, 3200).slow(8)).lpq(5)
  .decay(.1).sustain(0).delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).gain(.22)

// Vocal chop accent on the turnaround
vox: note("<~ [~ d4 ~ f4 ~ g4 ~ ~]>").s("aah")
  .attack(.01).decay(.15).sustain(0).release(.1)
  .delay(.35).delaytime(3/8).room(.4).gain(.3)

sketches.name: Cyber Sprint
sketches.description: Dark outrun synthwave at 134 BPM: relentless sixteenth-note bass, gated snares and a heroic minor-key lead for pushing through the final set.
sketches.source:
setcpm(134/4)

// Punchy 80s drums with big gated reverb on the snare
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").shape(.25).gain(.82),
  s("~ [sd,cp] ~ [sd,cp]").room(.65).size(.8).gain(.6),
  s("hh*16").hpf(7000).gain("[.3 .15]*8"),
  s("<~ ~ ~ [lt*2 mt*2 ht*4]>").room(.5).gain(.5)
)

// Relentless sixteenth-note bass: Cm, Ab, Fm, G
bass: note("<c1 ab0 f1 g1>").ply(16)
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(1100).lpq(4).lpenv(1.8).lpdecay(.07)
  .decay(.09).sustain(.15).release(.03).gain(.48)

//Heroic synth lead
lead: note("<[c4@2 d4 eb4 g4@3 f4] [eb4@2 d4 c4 bb3@4] [ab3@2 bb3 c4 f4@3 eb4] [d4@4 g4@4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2).mono(1).glide(.04)
  .lpf(3000).vib(5).vibdepth(.12)
  .attack(.01).decay(.3).sustain(.6).release(.15)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).gain(.28)

// Shimmering chord bed
pad: note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3] [f2,ab2,c3] [g2,b2,d3]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3).lpf(1600)
  .attack(.2).release(.8).room(.6).gain(.18)

sketches.name: Boxer's Jump Rope
sketches.description: High-stepping 112 BPM funk: a crisp skip-rope hi-hat, tight clavinet, punchy horn stabs and a slapping bass for footwork, shadowboxing and agility drills.
sketches.source:
setcpm(112/4)

// Tight breakbeat with a skip-rope sixteenth-note hat
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").shape(.15).gain(.8),
  s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd?0.3 ~ sd?0.2 ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").gain(.65),
  s("hh*16").hpf(7500).swing(3).gain("[.35 .15 .25 .15]*4")
)

// Bouncy slap-style bass
bass: note("e1 ~ e2 ~ g1 a1 b1 ~ e1 ~ d2 ~ b1 a1 g1 ~").swing(3)
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(950).lpenv(2.5).lpdecay(.08)
  .decay(.14).sustain(.2).release(.05).gain(.55)

// Percussive clavinet comping
clav: note("~ [e3,g3,b3] ~ [e3,g3,b3] [f#3,a3,c#4] ~ ~ [e3,g3,b3] ~ [e3,g3,b3] ~ [f#3,a3,c#4] ~ ~ [g3,b3,d4] ~").swing(3)
  .s("square").pw(.2).lpf(2600).lpq(5)
  .attack(.002).decay(.09).sustain(0).pan(.35).gain(.22)

// Brass section punches
horns: note("<[~ ~ ~ [b4,d5,g5] ~ [a4,c#5,f#5] ~ ~] [~ ~ ~ [g4,b4,e5]@2 ~ ~ ~]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.15)
  .lpf(1800).lpenv(2).lpattack(.02).lpdecay(.15)
  .attack(.01).decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.1).pan(.65).room(.3).gain(.3)

sketches.name: Cool-Down Stretch
sketches.description: Bring the heart rate back down at 64 BPM: a gentle halftime pulse, warm Rhodes chords, a deep sub and a slow four-bar breathing guide for post-workout stretching.
sketches.source:
setcpm(64/4)

// Soft halftime pulse to ease the heart rate down
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").lpf(220).gain(.45),
  s("~ ~ ~ ~ rim ~ ~ ~").room(.5).gain(.2),
  s("hh*8").hpf(7000).gain(.08)
)

// Warm Rhodes chords: Ebmaj7, Cm9, Abmaj7, Bb6 (hold each stretch for 4 bars)
keys: note("<[eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [c3,eb3,g3,d4] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,g3]>")
  .s("sine").fm(.9).fmh(2).trem(3).tremdepth(.2)
  .attack(.05).decay(1.5).sustain(.3).release(1.5)
  .lpf(1800).room(.7).size(.85).gain(.28)

// Deep, calm root bass
bass: note("<eb2 c2 ab1 bb1>").s("sine")
  .attack(.2).decay(1).sustain(.5).release(1).gain(.35)

// A gentle chime marks every four-bar stretch change
chime: note("<bb4 ~ ~ ~>").s("sine").fm(2).fmh(3.5)
  .decay(3).sustain(0).release(3).room(.8).gain(.16)
